gen-fs-expose-gf-gidole: Compressed and striking, with barely a breath between the letters. Gidole draws a monoline stroke from start to finish, terminals parted like scissor blades, a quiet foil for Expose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-inter-tight: Squeezed, striking and refined, with hardly a pause between letters. Expose grabs attention with its compressed stance, while Inter Tight hums along in rope-like lines with no thick-thin shift and short ascenders.
gen-fs-expose-gf-kufam: Striking up top and clean below, Expose compresses its letters while Kufam keeps one marker-like line weight throughout. Kufam's tall bodies dominate each line, leaving ascenders barely visible.
gen-fs-expose-gf-michroma: Expose packs its letters tight, striking and refined, with barely a pause. Michroma, a sans-serif, gives every letter a wide berth on both sides, with tall bodies and stubby ascender tips.
gen-fs-expose-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre writes a single-width line like a rolling-ball pen, with a lowercase of cast-iron stature. And Expose, compressed and low in contrast, supplies the striking headline above it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mozilla-text: A tightly packed, striking face that barely stops for breath. Expose is made to catch the eye, while Mozilla Text, a sans, reads boldly thanks to its tall-bodied lowercase and flared terminals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-nata-sans: Squeezed tight and striking, Expose barely lets a letter breathe. Nata Sans traces a constant-width line through the text like laser etching, with a large central band and wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-fs-expose-gf-nobile: Compressed and striking, Expose leaves hardly a pause between letters. Nobile keeps its letter mouths open like chalk arcs left unjoined, and shares that small step from lowercase to capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-nokora: Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Beneath Expose's compressed headings it feels sturdy and friendly, its s never tightening, so paragraphs would glide on and on.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads cleanly, with curve endings kept well apart and c, s and z standing tall and full. But Expose earns its keep in big, short bursts, where its compressed, striking build can dominate.
